channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Heightened emotions in Iran after Team Melli knocked out of World Cup
item.description: This is the second World Cup that comes after deadly nationwide protests inside Iran, and the first one amid a war

item.title: US and Iran trade strikes days after peace agreement
item.description: Just days after signing a memorandum of understanding, the US and Iran have traded strikes.

item.title: Israel strikes Lebanon, testing days-old peace deal
item.description: Hezbollah calls the deal a surrender as Israeli forces stay put and continue striking the south.

item.title: Three firefighters killed in US wildfires along Colorado–Utah border
item.description: The US has seen a harsh wildfire season this year, with prolonged droughts and dry conditions fuelling blazes.

item.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
item.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

item.title: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
item.description: The pilot and 10 passengers - including five first-time parachutists - died in the incident, local officials said.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
item.description: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.

item.title: Fourteen killed in Saudi Arabia helicopter crash
item.description: The aircraft belonged to state oil giant Aramco and the cause of the crash is being investigated.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon as Hezbollah condemns new deal
item.description: Strikes have killed at least one person, state media say a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement.
